sloka: शयनेषु महार्हेषु शयित्वा राक्षसेश्वर ।इह कस्मात् प्रसुप्तो ऽसि धरण्यां रेणुपाटलः ।। ६.११४.५७ ।।
transliteration: śayaneṣu mahārheṣu śayitvā rākṣaseśvara ।iha kasmāt prasupto 'si dharaṇyāṁ reṇupāṭalaḥ ।। 6.114.57 ।।

translations.english: "Such a husband of mine endowed with this kind of influence, killed by Rama, is lying here. Beholding the lover gone, I am holding this body and standing here."
